title: See which Plans touch a story or feature
statement: As an architect, I can see from a story or a feature which Plans touch it, so I can find the work planned against it without anyone keeping that list by hand.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A story's page lists the Tasks that link to it, the Tasks leading to those, and the Plans they belong to.
A feature's page lists the Plans whose Tasks link to its stories.
Those lists come from Tasks' story links; nobody authors a link from a Plan to a story or a feature.
After feature deliver moves a story to another feature, its Tasks still link to it and that feature's page lists their Plans.
